enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Choked by Mother Night: This weapon is unholy, dealing an additional 6d6 evil damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon evil aligned.Mother Night does not answer the prayers of her disciples without due cause. Strike those who disobey Her with this relic, and be rewarded.
Animal Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt the natural, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Animals.
Aberration Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt the unnatural, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Aberrations.
Vampirism 3: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +3d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
